issue: Does a dismissal under Heck v. Humphrey for failure to meet the favorable-termination requirement count as a PLRA strike under 28 U.S.C. § 1915(g)?

sides.position: A Heck dismissal always counts as a PLRA strike.
A Heck dismissal does not count as a PLRA strike because Heck is a timing rule, not a merits ruling.
cases: Mejia v. Harrington, 541 F. App'x 709 (7th Cir. 2013)

quote: The circuits that have considered the issue are split as to whether Heck dismissals count as PLRA strikes.
cite: Maurice Cotton v. New York State Office, No. 20-1644 (2d Cir. 2024)
